title: Mario's regression: "Because he's here"

tellings.quote: And the little one, the small one, just as plain as day, says, "Because he's here."

plain: During a regression, a session meant to bring back buried memories, Mario Woods recalled being on board a craft in 1977 and hearing a small being say plainly, "Because he's here." Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted, tells this himself in a 2026 episode where he reunites with others from that time. The story is tied to a man named Michael Johnson, whom Woods links to that remark.
